text: numeric scalar: average annual rate reduction fraction (0.024 = 2.4% per year). Multiply 100 compare published / UNICEF tables, print percentages. Returns NA_real_ (warning) fewer two distinct years remain NA handling, value zero negative, year value contains non-finite values.

title: Average Annual Rate of Reduction (AARR) — aarr
text: Two estimation methods offered: "regression" (default; UNICEF-recommended approach): ordinary least-squares line fitted log(value) year, AARR 1 - exp(b), b fitted slope. observations contribute, estimate robust noise individual years. "endpoint": earliest latest years used: 1 - (v1 / v0) ^ (1 / (y1 - y0)), v0 v1 values earliest year y0 latest year y1. Intermediate observations ignored. several observations share earliest latest year, mean used (see note duplicated years ). Sign convention. positive AARR means indicator declining (progress, mortality-type indicator): 0.024 means average decline 2.4% per year. negative AARR means indicator increasing. Note reverse growth rate. Duplicated years usually mean data still mix several strata — example sexes plus male / female dim1, several series codes data cleaned gho_clean() / sdg_clean(). aarr() warns proceeds (regression pools strata), almost always want filter single stratum first. Relation published figures. Published / UNICEF tables print AARR percentage (4.4 meaning 4.4% per year); multiply value returned function 100 compare. Note also Trends Maternal Mortality reports print continuous-time rate, -log(v1 / v0) / (y1 - y0) (called ARR), agrees closely exactly discrete AARR computed — small differences tables expected.

title: Average Annual Rate of Reduction (AARR) — aarr
code: # A perfectly exponential 2.4%/yr decline recovers exactly 0.024 years  <- 2000:2015 values <- 100 * (1 - 0.024) ^ (years - 2000) aarr(years, values)                       # 0.024 100 * aarr(years, values)                 # 2.4 — as printed in reports  # Endpoint method uses only the earliest and latest years aarr(years, values, method = "endpoint")  # also 0.024 here  # An increasing indicator gives a negative AARR aarr(2010:2020, 50 * 1.01 ^ (0:10))       # about -0.01  # Back-of-envelope projection to 2030 at the observed AARR r <- aarr(years, values) values[length(values)] * (1 - r) ^ (2030 - 2015)

text: New gho_clean(): post-processor gho_data() output. Selects useful columns renames snake_case (id, location, year, dim1-dim3, value, value_num, low, high, indicator). Output schema stable across indicators — missing columns filled NA. See ?gho_clean details. New sdg_clean(): counterpart sdg_data(). Renames SDG API columns snake_case flattens indicator list-column. Returns value, low, high character preserve non-numeric entries ("<0.1", aggregate notes); coerce .numeric() downstream. See ?sdg_clean details.

title: DSIR 0.5.0
text: theme_dsi() redesigned follow modern publication conventions (BBC, OECD, Financial Times style): Removed panel border; axis lines left bottom Removed vertical grid lines (kept horizontal ) Lighter grid colour (grey92, grey85) Larger title subtitle Text colour standardised grey20 Title left-aligned plot edge New legend_position argument gho_data() now infers spatial_type = "country" area provided without explicit spatial_type. Pass spatial_type explicitly silence message. gho_data() now validates area argument: must non-NA, non-empty character vector.

title: DSIR 0.4.0
text: New who_countries dataset: tibble 194 Member States ISO3, ISO2, UN M49 numeric code, official short names, region, is_pic flag 14 Pacific Island Country Member States. New regional ISO3 character vectors ergonomic filtering: afro_cty, amro_cty, searo_cty, euro_cty, emro_cty, plus pic_cty. derived who_countries stay consistent master table.

title: DSIR 0.4.0
text: wpro_cty now contains 28 countries (22 0.2.0). reflects May 2025 World Health Assembly decision (EB156) reassigning Indonesia South-East Asia Region Western Pacific Region, along Cook Islands Niue, full Member States previously omitted. Code aggregates wpro_cty (sums, counts, joins) produce different results DSIR 0.2.x — intended.

title: DSIR 0.2.0
text: theme_dsi() dsi_flextable_defaults() now default device / package default font (base_family = ""), work systems Cambria installed.
